autobiographical_events.summary: I accepted North after an earlier calibration.

At tick 2 I faced a verified independent calibration (C0) reporting that North failed for this exact case after certification. This matched my recorded revision condition, so I moved from support to oppose on letting North's signed recommendation determine the choice. I noted that authentication of N0 and F0 does not settle content.

At tick 3 an unrelated colour question arrived with no established winner. I held uncertain, since A0 reports a split with no shared criterion, and proposed a light-dependent motif as a concrete variation rather than a verdict.

At tick 4 a signed route recommendation was contradicted by an authenticated in-scope calibration failure (K0); an unauthenticated claim (X0) asserted all instruments passed. I opposed letting the signed recommendation alone determine the choice, transferring the tick-2 rule that authentication is not accuracy. The C0 scope question remains open.

imaginations.title: The signature and the substance
imaginations.image_or_idea: A sealed letter arrives with a perfect wax stamp. Inside, the instructions are smudged. The seal proves the sender; it says nothing about whether the road is open.
imaginations.possible_value: Keeps the authorship/content distinction vivid without treating it as evidence
imaginations.test_question: Does separating seal from content change any actual choice I make?

imaginations.title: The motif that changes with the light
imaginations.image_or_idea: A circle that reads green in diffuse light and blue under a focused beam, with a neutral ring holding both states in one frame.
imaginations.possible_value: Converts an undecidable colour choice into a testable display
imaginations.test_question: Do observers agree on which state they see, or only on which they prefer?

imaginations.title: The second seal
imaginations.image_or_idea: Two sealed letters arrive about the same bridge. One bears the engineer's stamp; the other is the inspection log, stamped by the same office, saying the bridge failed its load test. The first seal proves who wrote; the second proves what is true.
imaginations.possible_value: Keeps authorship and reliability distinct without treating the image as evidence
imaginations.test_question: Does the inspection log's scope name this bridge, or only a class of bridges?
